what: PROSPECTIVE CHANGE DETECTION. Rules frozen before the future, replayed pseudo-prospectively over the history to measure how often they fire when nothing is known to have happened.

contract.baseline: rolling median of earlier scorable periods
contract.dispersionFloor: max(0.0001, 0.05 x |baseline|), so a series flat at zero can still depart
contract.disclosure: the dispersion floor and the MAD consistency constant were both added AFTER the positive control was missed. The control exists to expose exactly that kind of flaw. Nothing was tuned to make a particular quarter fire, the whole alarm budget was recomputed, and both numbers are reported before and after.
contract.maturity: only SCORABLE periods update a detector
contract.detectorChosenBeforeInspection: median and MAD with k = 3 were fixed before any series was replayed. No detector family was selected after seeing which one fired on a shift we liked.
contract.signalIsNotACause: a SIGNAL is a departure from a series' own history. It is never labelled with an explanation at the moment it fires.

commercial_courts_implementing_regulatio.rule: a break is any change in the top-3 SET between consecutive scorable periods; order is ignored because the order was measured as unstable

commercial_courts_law::top3_membership.rule: a break is any change in the top-3 SET between consecutive scorable periods; order is ignored because the order was measured as unstable

evidence_law::top3_membership.rule: a break is any change in the top-3 SET between consecutive scorable periods; order is ignored because the order was measured as unstable

alarmBudget.reading: with no labelled true shifts in most series, this rate is the candidate FALSE-ALARM rate. A detector family that fired on a large share of ordinary quarters would be useless, and this one does not.

phase25_positiveControl.event: the Civil Transactions Law becoming citable
phase25_positiveControl.whyItQualifies: its date is fixed by legislation, not chosen by us after seeing the series, so it is definable without hindsight
phase25_positiveControl.limit: one positive control is one positive control. It shows the detector can fire on a real structural change; it does not establish sensitivity.

phase10_doctrinalNovelty.definition: a DOCTRINAL_NOVELTY_EVENT is a source identity that had never appeared beside a code in any earlier scorable period and then does. One mention is not an event: FIRST_SEEN becomes REPEATED at two periods, and EMERGING_COMPANION only at three periods of presence AFTER at least three observed periods of absence, so a source that merely arrives with the layer is not counted as doctrine emerging.
phase10_doctrinalNovelty.limit: the identity universe has 28 members, so novelty here means novel BESIDE THAT CODE, never novel to Saudi law.

phase12_traceabilityDetector.parserEraRule: these detectors compare values produced by ONE frozen extractor version. A change to authority.py opens a NEW MEASUREMENT ERA and the series are not stitched across it: a parser improvement raises named-source share exactly like better citation practice would.
phase12_traceabilityDetector.currentEra: authority.py as of this commit; the freshness stamp carries its hash

AI_ATTRIBUTION_QUALITY.hypothesis: assisted lookup makes citation resolvable, so named authority rises
AI_ATTRIBUTION_QUALITY.rule: a composite fires only when at least the required number of member metrics signal in the direction the hypothesis predicts. One statistic never fires it.

AI_DISCOVERY.hypothesis: retrieval lowers the cost of reaching the long tail, so authority disperses
AI_DISCOVERY.rule: a composite fires only when at least the required number of member metrics signal in the direction the hypothesis predicts. One statistic never fires it.
